hypothesisAssessment.hypothesis: The current external-Chrome provider does not implement or enable the optional webmcp tab capability.
hypothesisAssessment.evidence: Chrome advertises only pageAssets on a page visibly reporting three native registrations; the same app's in-app-browser provider advertises webmcp.

hypothesisAssessment.hypothesis: Current mode/model/account eligibility with a different supported consumer explains the difference.
hypothesisAssessment.evidence: No independent ChatGPT Work Sol/Terra consumer was tested. The provider advertisement is definitive only for the current Codex Chrome provider.

hypothesisAssessment.hypothesis: Stale client or connection state caused the prior result.
hypothesisAssessment.evidence: A newly initialized connection using Browser package 26.825.32147 reproduced the provider advertisement and capability error.

hypothesisAssessment.hypothesis: The project extension's registration, schema, world, or timing causes capability acquisition to fail.
hypothesisAssessment.evidence: Chrome accepted/inventoried/executed the extension tool previously; current page-provided registrations still do not add webmcp to the Chrome provider.

hypothesisAssessment.hypothesis: Chrome/WebMCP API-version drift affects provider compatibility.
hypothesisAssessment.evidence: The provider exposes no webmcp interface from which inventory or invocation compatibility could be measured.

conclusion.immediateCause: The current Codex Chrome provider does not advertise the optional webmcp tab capability.
conclusion.nextDecision: Obtain platform/provider support or explicitly review a different consumer/bridge architecture.

limitations: Capability advertisement is an authoritative statement about the supported Browser surface for this connection, not a view of the closed-source provider implementation.
The in-app-browser differential is provider advertisement plus historical positive invocation evidence; no fresh in-app tab was selected or invoked in this run.
No Chrome profile, cookies, local storage, hidden transport, direct CDP, or Browser implementation internals were inspected.
No project runtime, browser setting, extension permission, model, or account was changed.
The user-pasted non-Work output is retained only as corroborating context and cannot establish ChatGPT Work behavior.
